ablation_analysis.velocity_ablation_note: Velocity signals require multi-message temporal event streams (sender/IP sliding windows). On the static held-out test suite (N = 400), velocity is fixed to 0.0 to isolate content inspection. Velocity contributions are evaluated under synthetic multi-message velocity sweeps in test_telecom_gateway.py.
